verdict.rationale: API parity with the UI is a fair question for a tax agency's online services, which could expose filing or payment APIs, so the axis applies. The evidence shows only Akamai 403 denials at the front door and the MyFTB/Web Pay host. Nothing documents any API, let alone one matching the UI, so absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
